changelog:
Initial release for YBoard Operator skill.

- Enables navigation and editing of video/presentation plans on yboard.online.
- Supports scene selection, mode switching, and text field editing (title, goal, visual guide, narration, assets).
- Allows adding or replacing scene illustrations using Draw Custom Image, with guidance for clean visuals.
- Provides a clear workflow and specific illustration rules to ensure high-quality, readable presentations.
summary: Operate yboard.online to navigate scenes, edit text fields, switch modes, and add clear, text-free hero visuals following yboard illustration rules.
